conviction_note: The quarter's main revenue line, Leqembi royalty of SEK 203.8m, was pre-released on 2026-10-28, and the Novartis termination (2026-11-02) lands in Q4. BioArctic gives no financial guidance and I found no sourced Q3 2026 consensus, so nothing decides the sign: p_up 50. The release still carries unseen opex, other revenue, cash and possibly a lumpy milestone. On report days this name moved 1.5-12.4% over the past year even with royalties pre-released, so abs_move is 5.5. The findings sum to +0.1 and the scaled number is 0. They agree.

My own arithmetic puts operating profit near break-even to slightly positive; no consensus is sourced. Unknown sign against the bar.
The size of the Novartis remaining-upfront recognition in Q4, likely disclosed as a subsequent event. Non-cash and already announced; small.
Possible unannounced Eisai milestone. Q1 2026 carried SEK 218.8m that consensus had not modelled. Unknown, not sourced.
Cash SEK 1,990m at end of Q2; small change expected. Unknown.
The company gives no financial guidance; no change expected.

findings.finding: The Q3 royalty, the largest revenue line, was pre-released at SEK 203.8m (+74% YoY, +14% QoQ against 179.4m in Q2), so the reported quarter's top line is largely known before the print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Royalties were also pre-released for Q1 and Q2 2026. Q1 beat EBIT consensus (210.8 vs 66) and closed +1.51%; Q2 beat (-6.5 vs -33) and closed -6.67% after +4.61% the day before. A pre-released royalty line has not decided the sign.
findings.original_quote: Försäljningen av Leqembi® uppgick till 32,2 miljarder yen under det tredje kvartalet 2026 (Swedish headline of the bilingual release; English body: 'This results in a royalty to BioArctic amounting to SEK 203.8 million, which is an increase of approximately 74 percent')
findings.why_not_priced: It IS priced: published as inside information four weeks before the print. The stock rose +2.04% that day on doubled volume. Filed at 0 because the market has been told the number.
findings.independence: Eisai's Q3 Leqembi number came out alongside Biogen's Q3 report, same underlying fact; https://www.inderes.dk/releases/bioarctic-sales-of-leqembir-totaled-322-billion-yen-in-the-third-quarter-2026

findings.finding: Novartis terminated the BrainTransporter deal on 2026-11-02. BioArctic keeps the USD 30m upfront and will recognise the unrecognised remainder as 2026 revenue (a Q4 non-cash one-off), which the Q3 report will likely quantify as a subsequent event.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On 2026-11-03 the stock opened -7.6% (286.6 vs 310.2) and closed +0.39% on about 3x normal volume, so the market looked through the loss of the up-to-USD-770m milestone stream within one session.
findings.original_quote: BioArctics samarbetspartner Novartis avslutar avtal (Swedish headline; English body: 'BioArctic will retain the full USD 30 million upfront payment and, as a result of the termination, will recognize the remaining unrecognized portion as revenue in 2026')
findings.why_not_priced: The termination itself is priced (the intraday round-trip on 11-03). Only the SEK amount of the Q4 catch-up may be new. It is non-cash, belongs to the next quarter and has no path to a guide, because BioArctic gives none. Hence a fraction of a point.
findings.independence: Fierce Biotech coverage of the same event, same fact: https://www.fiercebiotech.com/biotech/novartis-scraps-800m-bioartic-neuroscience-collab-after-barely-year

baseline_tension: The lean is essentially flat (-0.108, run-up only, no short anchor) and the 5-day run-up is +5.2%, almost all from the exidavnemab release. Nothing I found cuts for or against it. The one precedent (Q2 2026: +4.6% the day before, then -6.7% on a beat) is n=1 and moves nothing.
language_note: Finwire/Placera's Swedish Q2 2026 preview carried the company's report-day move table (Q2-2024 through Q1-2026: 8.5, 29.9, 1.8, 11.0, 11.8, 7.2, 12.4, 1.5 %). That table set abs_move_pct; the baseline's cadence-estimated history (median 5.09) sits on wrong dates. No English source carried it.
Finwire's Swedish wire carried the Modular Finance consensus and outcome tables for Q1 and Q2 2026, showing four straight operating-profit beats. The English sources carried none of it.
The issuer's own filings are fully bilingual (identical English and Swedish releases on the Nasdaq Nordic feed), so on the filings nothing was added by Swedish.
lessons_applied: A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0: the pre-released royalty finding went from +0.3 to 0.0.
A one-off with no path to the guide is a fraction of the same money as operating profit: the Novartis Q4 recognition went from +0.2 to +0.1.

Size the move on what is new and let reaction history move p_up, not abs: abs_move_pct kept at 5.5 above the 3% pre-released base, because of thin coverage (3 estimates in Q2) and the name's report-day moves of 1.5-12.4% on royalty-pre-released quarters. p_up stays 50.
